CS 1410 — Diagrams & Steppers

Interactive walkthroughs for CS 1410: Object-Oriented Programming. Nothing to install; each one works offline once loaded.

Module 0 · Where your code actually runs Four tabs on the two sides of the container boundary: before you click anything, Reopen in Container, which side am I on, and when it goes wrong. Module 0 · From .cpp to a running program Eight tabs: what main.cpp is, why there is a second file, how a build works, and the two ways it breaks. Module 1 · C++ basics for Python programmers Seven tabs, most of them wrong on purpose first: integer division, { } and narrowing, const, branch order, switch fall-through, and loops. Module 1 · Lining up columns with setw Four tabs with every space drawn as a dot and a character ruler above, because padding is made of spaces and spaces are invisible in a listing. Module 1 · Holdfast — the board appears Six tabs through the game's scaffolding and its tests. It stops where your own function bodies begin. Module 2 · Branches & pull requests Four tabs: what a repo looks like, branching, the pull request and its diff, and what to do when it goes wrong.
